home.title: Chocolate Cakes Sydney | Melrose Park Pickup | Very Good
home.description: Order small-batch chocolate cakes for pre-arranged pickup in Melrose Park, Sydney. Pave cake, chocolate Basque cheesecake, pound cake and cupcakes from AUD 45.
home.hero: Small-batch chocolate cakes made to order for birthdays, parties and gifting.
home.pickup: Pre-order only. Pickup in Melrose Park, Sydney. No walk-in shop or delivery.
orderingSteps: Send a request so availability can be checked.
Receive payment details after availability is confirmed.
Collect by pre-arranged pickup in Melrose Park after final confirmation.

faq.question: Where do I pick up my cake?
faq.answer: Pickup is arranged in Melrose Park, Sydney. There is no walk-in shop, so the exact meeting details are shared after the order is confirmed.

faq.question: Is submitting a request a confirmed order?
faq.answer: No. Availability is checked first, payment details are sent, and the order is confirmed after payment is received.

faq.question: Do you offer Sydney delivery or walk-in sales?
faq.answer: Not currently. Cakes are made for pre-arranged pickup in Melrose Park only.
